jobs.title: Supply Chain Security Officer: Patrol & Protect
jobs.description: JCPenney is looking for a Supply Chain Security Officer in Cedar Hill, Texas, to maintain a safe and profitable facility by executing programs and investigating suspicious activities. You will have a key role in surveillance, emergency response, and report writing, ensuring a secure environment. This position offers a competitive benefits package that includes medical/dental/vision insurance, paid vacation, and a 401(k) with company match. The pay range is $17.50 to $22.00 per hour.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Security Officer – Surveillance & Loss Prevention
jobs.description:
JCPenney is seeking a Supply Chain Security Officer to help keep facilities safe and profitable by executing security programs and investigating suspicious activities. The role includes surveillance, incident reporting, and ensuring compliance across all access points.

You will operate CCTV systems, support shrinkage prevention, and respond to emergencies as needed, including entry control and post patrol duties across the facility.
